models.name: span_v2
models.license: arch Apache-2.0 (umzi2/traiNNer-redux; Conv3XC from TArdelean/DynamicConvolution MIT); weights personal use (TAS mirror)
models.recommended_for: anime x2 - SPAN family, higher quality than CUGAN-class models
models.notes: SPAN arch (2.2M params): 20 reparameterizable Conv3XC blocks + sigmoid-gated SPAB attention; trained with norm=False (no input normalization). Kernel fusion runs once after load. No size constraints.

models.notes: Cyte V1 SuperUltraCompact (0.05M params): umzi2 compact SRVGG (Conv+PReLU stack + PixelShuffle + nearest-neighbor residual). models.name: rife_425
models.license: MIT
models.recommended_for: default frame interpolation (all content)
models.notes: Practical-RIFE 4.25 flownet.pkl - upstream's recommended default for most scenes. The Drive link serves a zipped folder bundle; extract_member picks the checkpoint out of it.

models.name: rife_425_heavy
models.license: MIT (Practical-RIFE); weights mirrored by TAS-Models-Host
models.recommended_for: highest-quality interpolation; ~2x the compute of default RIFE 4.25
models.notes: Channel-doubled IFNet variant of RIFE 4.25. No official 'heavy' release exists upstream, so this uses the TAS community mirror (same file TAS's own registry points at).

models.name: rife_425_lite
models.license: MIT
models.recommended_for: fast interpolation; slightly lower quality than default RIFE 4.25
models.notes: Narrow final-block variant of RIFE 4.25 (block4 c=24). An official 4.25.lite exists on Practical-RIFE's Drive, but the TAS mirror is a single-file download.

models.name: m2m
models.license: Adobe Research License (non-commercial research only; no redistribution) ⚠️
models.recommended_for: experimental: efficient at high multipliers (4x-8x) - motion estimated once per pair
models.notes: M2M_VFI (feinanshan), CVPR'22 many-to-many splatting. Single-file Drive download (cached as m2m.bin). Arch vendored from Test/model/; the cupy softsplat/costvol kernels are rewritten in pure torch with identical math. Runner: PyTorch-CUDA only — the softsplat splat is an index_add_ scatter with data-dependent boundary masks that ONNX cannot represent, so there is no TensorRT path (same blocker as GMFSS). Flow is estimated once per pair; each intermediate slot costs occlusion metrics + a 4-branch splat.

models.name: gmfss
models.license: code MIT (GMFSS_Fortuna, 98mxr); weights: no license file upstream ⚠️ (personal use only)
models.recommended_for: experimental: anime-oriented interpolation; TAS's best-maintained community variant
models.notes: GMFSS (routineLife1/GMFSS, archived) union-variant weights as mirrored by TAS; arch vendored from GMFSS_Fortuna (98mxr, MIT). The zip bundle extracts to a directory of 5 checkpoints (union names renamed to canonical). Runner: PyTorch-CUDA only — the softsplat splatting is an index_add_ scatter with data-dependent boundary masks that ONNX cannot represent, so there is no TensorRT path; fp16 below UHD / fp32 at/above it, flow computed at half res above 1080p (TAS rule), per-pair reuse cache. Weights carry no upstream license: personal use only per project decision D3.

models.name: amt_sicdia
models.license: TBD ⚠️
models.recommended_for: experimental: SOTA large-motion interpolation; also the planned ghost-repair alternate model (M4)
models.notes: AMT-SICDIA (Adaptive Motion Transformer). Public weights URL not located as of 2026-09-17; confirm at adapter time. Adapter not yet implemented.

models.name: scunet
models.license: arch Apache-2.0 (cszn/SCUNet); weights personal use (TAS mirror of KAIR v1.0)
models.recommended_for: AI flicker/noise repair in the artifact-QA stage
models.notes: Swin-Conv-UNet blind denoiser, color-real-psnr checkpoint (17.95M params; config=[4]*7 verified strict against this file — NOT the class default [2]*7). Input is internally padded to a multiple of 64; output is the full denoised image in [0,1] with no residual add. The QA flicker repair runs it per frame on flagged static regions as a stabilizing pass (deterministic denoise of near-constant inputs collapses temporal variance).

models.name: deepdeband_f
models.license: arch BSD-3 (pytorch-CycleGAN-and-pix2pix) + MIT (RaymondLZhou/deepDeband); weights personal use (TAS mirror)
models.recommended_for: AI banding repair in the artifact-QA stage
models.notes: pix2pix unet_256 generator (8 downsamplings, ngf=64, BatchNorm; 54.4M params). The checkpoint is a plain UnetGenerator256 state dict ('model.*' keys) — the loader remaps it onto the wrapper's .net attribute. Input dims must be multiples of 256 (the wrapper reflect-pads internally); [-1,1] range mapping lives inside the wrapper. Heavier per pixel than SR models at 4K: expect the tiled-inference path to engage when other processes hold VRAM.

models.name: depth_anything_v2_small
models.license: Apache-2.0 (Depth-Anything-V2)
models.recommended_for: general-purpose depth maps (per-frame; all content types)
models.notes: Official Depth-Anything V2 Small (vits, 239-key strict checkpoint). Per-frame inference: quality high = each axis rounded up to a multiple of 14 (aspect preserved), medium = 700x700, low = 518x518 (TAS calculateAspectRatio parity). Output is per-frame min-max stretched grayscale at source resolution. Fixed-shape fp16 TRT engine per process size; PyTorch-CUDA bf16-autocast fallback.

models.name: limbo_v1
models.license: weights CC BY-NC 4.0 + TAS commercial grant (NevermindNilas/Ai-models) - mark NC in UI ⚠️; personal use OK per project decision D3
models.recommended_for: anime depth maps — temporally consistent video streaming
models.notes: Limbo v1: anime finetune of DA3-small (25.9M params, runtime-format checkpoint with cam_enc/cam_dec extras the loader allows). Streaming multi-view inference over sliding windows (4/8/16/32 frames, 50% overlap + median-scale alignment) so depth stays temporally stable; input is fixed at 504x280 (widescreen) or 504x378 (squarer), picked by source aspect ratio. TRT engine uses the TAS-validated streaming export (FP16 with attention MatMuls + Resize/LayerNorm/Softmax/Exp kept FP32; dynamic view axis). Output: 1/depth disparity + per-frame 2/98-percentile stretch at source resolution.

models.name: limbo_v2
models.license: weights CC BY-NC 4.0 + TAS commercial grant (NevermindNilas/Ai-models) - mark NC in UI ⚠️; personal use OK per project decision D3
models.recommended_for: anime depth maps — default (newer finetune, recommended)
models.notes: Limbo v2: anime finetune of DA3-small, same streaming architecture as limbo_v1 (windowed multi-view + overlap alignment; fixed 504x280 / 504x378 inputs by aspect). Hosted on NevermindNilas/Ai-models (raw.githubusercontent), not TAS-Models-Host — the file is named Limbo.safetensors upstream but lives in its own per-version cache dir, so there is no collision with v1. Default depth model for the Anime preset.

models.name: depth_anything_3_small
models.license: Apache-2.0 (Depth-Anything-3)
models.recommended_for: experimental: temporally consistent video depth (general content)
models.notes: Official Depth-Anything-3 small checkpoint, run through the same TAS-validated streaming path as Limbo (windowed multi-view + overlap alignment). Note: input is fixed at 504x280 / 504x378 by aspect ratio — unlike TAS's CUDA-only DA3 mode which negotiates a dynamic process resolution; the TRT export only supports the two validated shapes. Checkpoint carries training-only *_aux heads (allowed missing) and no camera extras.

models.name: depth_anything_3_base
models.license: Apache-2.0 (Depth-Anything-3)
models.recommended_for: experimental: highest-quality video depth in the lineup (slower than small)
models.notes: Official Depth-Anything-3 base checkpoint (vitb backbone, ~541 MB) on the same streaming path as limbo/da3-small. Heavier per window: expect longer inference at large windows; VRAM headroom guard skips TRT builds when another process holds most of the GPU and falls back to PyTorch-CUDA bf16 autocast.
